title: For a compact homogeneous space with generically locally free cotangent action, an invariant real-semisimple Nijenhuis cotangent pencil is generically Kronecker exactly when every associated semidirect contraction has the original Lie-algebra index
author: Konrad Lompert; Andriy Panasyuk
source_title: Invariant Nijenhuis Tensors and Integrable Geodesic Flows
difficulty_reason: The proof must control the singular pencil values after quotienting a cotangent bundle, where generic Hamiltonian reduction alone does not determine Kroneckerity. The author parametrizes exceptional symplectic leaves by quotient-dual functionals, identifies their stabilizer actions and computes each reduced corank as a stabilizer index plus orbit codimension. A simultaneous regular-leaf argument and contraction-index formula turn these geometric coranks into a necessary and sufficient finite Lie-algebra criterion.
source_version: Official SIGMA 15 (2019) article 056, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2019.056; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The full Theorem5.1 proof and all essential reduction/lift support were read: invariant eigendistributions and Lie-subalgebra decomposition, cotangent Poisson pencil, exceptional-leaf parametrization and momentum maps (4.8–4.10), the reduced-pencil corank criterion (3.7), and the full stabilizer/orbit corank computation (5.4). The author proves both necessity and sufficiency on the specified open dense regular set, including transversal exceptional-leaf intersection and regular functional selection. The equivalence with the semidirect-product index criterion is supplied via Lemma5.2, which explicitly credits the Rais formula and index monotonicity under contraction. No new geodesic-flow example or separate integrability consequence is counted.

statement_scope: Exactly Theorem5.1: G is a compact Lie group, K a closed subgroup, and the natural G-action on T^*(G/K) is generically locally free with finite principal stabilizer H. N is a G-invariant invertible semisimple Nijenhuis tensor on G/K with distinct constant real eigenvalues lambda_i and the indicated eigenspace Lie-subalgebra decomposition g=sum_i g_i modulo k. Let check(g)_i=sum_{j!=i} g_j. On the principal-stratum quotient and the exact open dense regular set p(W) constructed in the proof, the reduced pencil from the canonical bivector Pi and its cotangent N-lift Pi_1 is Kronecker iff ind(check(g)_i semidirect (g/check(g)_i))=ind(g) for every i. Equivalently retain the stated existence of quotient-dual a_i with stabilizer index plus orbit codimension equal to ind(g). No assertion at singular strata or without the locally free action hypothesis, and no separate metric-integrability corollary, is selected.
editorial_warning: The compactness and finite principal stabilizer assumptions occur immediately before the printed theorem and are essential; they are included in the title and context. The theorem concerns generic points of its specified regular set p(W), not the entire quotient. The source writes several dummy-index slips in momentum-map formulas; the local coordinate expressions and corresponding intrinsic definitions are both included unchanged.
